<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For two image-finite models, agreement on all finite branching tests is equivalent to a bisimulation relating the two positions.

Canonical source: [Likeness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Likeness.lean)
